item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 29 November 2023, Germany's Federal Constitutional Court declared provisions of the 2020 electoral reform underlying the 2021 Bundestag election constitutional, finding them compatible with the constitutional requirement of definiteness, equal and direct voting, and party equality; the ruling also clarified the electoral law applicable to a possible partial repeat election in Berlin, for which the Berlin state and federal election authorities had begun preparations.","notes":["Narrowed “legal certainty” to the excerpt’s stated constitutional requirement of definiteness (Bestimmtheitsgebot).","Specified the election authorities named in the excerpt."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
